deviations_from_adr: MoneyInput made HOOK-FREE (no useState focus-toggle) vs the ADR's implied focus/blur raw-vs-grouped display swap: the web test harness (vitest node env, no jsdom/react-dom/react-test-renderer) cannot invoke a hook-using component as a plain function, which is this codebase's established control-testing convention. Trade-off: grouping is always shown (derived from the value prop each render), not swapped to raw-on-focus — a common industry pattern; cursor may jump to end when a grouping separator is inserted mid-type. Data integrity is unaffected (onChange stores the raw numeric string).

DateInput implemented as native <input type=date> + transparent-text + дд.мм.гггг overlay (NOT a bespoke popover calendar): keeps full native keyboard/a11y/picker semantics (proven working live) with zero regression risk, avoids a from-scratch calendar widget; locale-independent numeric display achieved via the overlay.

datetime type scoped to the CLIENT record/form stack (apps-schema.js/records-form.js/field-contract.js/field-renderer.jsx) — NOT extended into the server binding-contract-catalog.ts/field-type-dictionary.ts (BPMN form-binding) nor view-config.ts/view-query.ts (view filter/sort operators). Those are separate larger subsystems the UX study did not flag for datetime; datetime degrades safely to a filterable/sortable string there. See FINDINGS.
friction_events: Session-continuity scare: coordinator reported a transient API failure lost the final report and warned nothing was committed. On resume, git status + git diff --stat confirmed ALL in-tree edits had actually persisted (no rework needed) — continued exactly from the pending test-authoring step.

An invisible non-breaking space (U+00A0) was inserted by the editor into groupThousands' separator replacement string, causing a byte-mismatch test failure that rendered as visually-identical strings in the vitest diff. Diagnosed via charCodeAt; normalized to a regular ASCII space (U+0020) for testability; MoneyInput's onChange strips all whitespace (incl. NBSP via \s) before storing.

anti-case-lock.sh RED on the first gate pass: a new test fixture used seeded-persona literals (e-larina/Е. Ларина) which the D-064 anti-case gate forbids even in tests. Replaced with generic synthetic fixtures (emp-1/Human One/Position A); gate green.

Server-suite flake (non-blocking): src/__tests__/forms-from-schema.test.ts SP-1 timed out under full-parallel load (10192ms) once, passed solo (4225ms). Unrelated to this change (web/src-only diff); re-ran solo → green.

Three pre-existing field-renderer tests (money/date structural tree-walks) went RED after wrapping money/date in the new MoneyInput/DateInput sub-components — expected structural consequence of the refactor; updated the tests to invoke the (now-exported, hook-free) sub-components, matching the file's existing RelationPickerField/DateRangeField pattern.

checks.money_kopecks_intact: GREEN — typed 150000.5, POST /api/records stored exact 150000.5 (no rounding), list/detail/edit-form all display "150 000,50 ₽" (grouped thousands, kopecks preserved) confirming the documented P1 fix (formatCellValue previously used maximumFractionDigits:0 which silently rounded to "150 001 ₽")
checks.person_field_loads_and_searches: GREEN — dropdown populated with all 7 real tenant employees on open (not "Не удалось загрузить"), typed "Ларина" and list filtered to exactly one matching employee, selection stored as employee slug, re-editing correctly re-highlights the same employee by name
checks.date_format_ddmmyyyy: GREEN — native <input type=date> with dd.mm.yyyy overlay confirmed on all 4 surfaces: create form, list column, record detail, edit form re-population — all show 15.08.2026, never raw ISO

findings_beyond_scope: P1: list and record-detail screens display the person field as the raw employee slug (e-larina) instead of a resolved display name, unlike relation/file types which have dedicated async-resolve cell components (RELATION_CELL_ASYNC/FILE_CELL_ASYNC). The formatCellValue code comment (records-form.js:1270-1278) explicitly says the caller SHOULD pre-resolve via GET /api/org but screen-app-records.jsx never does this for type==="person". The PersonPicker itself resolves correctly bidirectionally in the create/edit form (confirmed live) — only the read-only list/detail rendering is affected. Not a blocker for this task (all 3 requested checks are GREEN) but a real UX debt worth a follow-up task.
live_proof.bypasses_found: none — all checks performed via real UI (typed values, clicked selections); network interception used read-only for verifying already-performed UI actions
